entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A human warrior of the Sun Empire on Ixalan who lost her left eye in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Warrior-poet of the Sun Empire whom Wayta admires; cousin of Inti.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin whose blade, with his Echo, was given to Wayta.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Wayta lost her left eye.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Raiders Wayta sailed with for a year.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: Friend Wayta made in the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Member of the expedition to the plane's core.

entities.name: Caparocti Sunborn
entities.description: Sun Empire leader of the expedition.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Bat-demon foe of the warriors at the plane's core.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: Fought alongside Aclazotz and his bat-demons.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: Where Wayta settled at sixteen or seventeen.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Allies of the warriors at the plane's core.

events.summary: Wayta, no older than thirteen, meets her idol Huatli.
At the outbreak of the invasion Wayta lies about her age to join the Sun Empire forces and loses her left eye in Tocatli.
events.quote: she lied about her age to join the Sun Empire forces in defense of her plane

events.summary: After the Invasion, Wayta joins the Brazen Coalition for a year, befriends Malcolm Lee, then returns home through faith in the Threefold Sun.
Wayta joins the expedition from Orazca to the plane's core and fights Aclazotz, Vito and the bat-demons with the Oltec.

relations.quote: Wayta is a human warrior of the Sun Empire
The flying dinosaur Ajij is her companion.
